_note: FTL = Full Tank Level, the gazetted boundary of a lake. A lake gets a PRELIMINARY notification, then a FINAL one after objections. Until the final notification issues the boundary is not legally settled, which is the state encroachment thrives in. The per-lake FTL, cadastral and buffer-zone sheets behind this register are scanned raster PDFs with no extractable text, so no machine-readable polygon exists; this file is the tabular register only.
